Other devices signed in to your own Google account find this broadcast without a server. Only the announcement is written to the hidden app folder of your Drive, never the sound or the picture. The choice is remembered separately for audio and for the camera. Off writes nothing.
What is written to Google Drive

While the broadcast runs, this app writes a small announcement file to the hidden app folder of your own Google account: the broadcast\'s title, this phone\'s name and the addresses a listener can try. The stream itself never goes through Google Drive. The file is removed when the broadcast stops. This switch stays off unless you turn it on.
